[[File:LograysPotion.png|thumb|right|280px|Logray giving Wicket the antidote]]'''Logray's antidote''' was a potion developed by the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Logray/Legends|Logray]], [[Shaman/Legends|Shaman]] of the [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], to counter a [[Morag's potion|poisonous brew]] created by his archfoe, the [[Tulgah/Legends|Tulgah]] [[Witch/Legends|witch]] named [[Morag]]. With her own potion, Morag had poisoned the Ewoks' [[Berry/Legends|berry]] bushes in order to deprive them of their favorite food. Logray, however, was able to prepare an antidote that not only disinfected the [[Fruit/Legends|fruits]], but also made the repellent to the witch.
